summary: Frontend-only regression: STAMPEDE SET Vault card mobile clipping fix and new bangle-white-pedestal.png gallery asset. Executed 26 UI assertions across 3 viewports (375x800 mobile, 768x1024 tablet, 1440x900 desktop) + detail-page gallery/CTA regression. 100% of critical assertions passed (25/25 on index; 10/11 on detail — the sole 'fail' was a test-side false negative: Add-to-Cart uses a cart drawer + success toast pattern instead of a button-text swap; drawer opened with 'Your Cart (1)', item 'STAMPEDE SET — Pavé Ring & Pavé Bangle' at $150 USD, and localStorage confirmed unit_amount_cents:15000, verified visually via screenshot). No regressions on sibling Vault cards.

mobile_375x800_stampede_card.card_bbox: x=20 y=76.5 w=335 h=635.5 (all children fit within)

detailed_verifications.tablet_768x1024_grid: All 7 Vault cards (driven, nova, caged-wings, monaco, oriel, parabola-atelier, stampede-set) render with non-zero size and existing test IDs intact
detailed_verifications.desktop_1440x900_grid: All 7 Vault cards render (widths 1285px, heights 200-1511px); parabola-atelier is a compact card (237px) which matches its existing 'coming soon / atelier' variant — pre-existing design, unchanged
detailed_verifications.click_3rd_thumb: main image src switches to bangle-white-pedestal.png ✓
detailed_verifications.add_to_cart: Functional. Opens cart drawer with 'Your Cart (1)', item 'STAMPEDE SET — Pavé Ring & Pavé Bangle' at $150 USD; toast 'STAMPEDE SET — Pavé Ring & Pavé Bangle added to your cart' displayed; localStorage phileon_cart contains product_id=inspiration-vault-stampede-set, unit_amount_cents=15000, sku=IV-STAMPEDE-SET

critical_code_review_comments: The scoped CSS override .stampede-set-vault-card in InspirationVaultPage.jsx (lines ~1045-1150) is correctly scoped by class — no other Vault card class names are affected. Verified at runtime: all sibling cards retain their existing dimensions and test IDs.

Add-to-Cart success state on StampedeSetPage uses a cart drawer + toast pattern rather than a button text swap. The button label remains 'ADD TO CART' even after success — consider adding a transient 'ADDED ✓' state on data-testid='ss-add-to-cart' for better testability and accessibility feedback (currently only visible feedback is the drawer overlay + toast).

Archive tag text renders as 'Archive Piece' (title case) in the DOM even though the design spec/tests refer to it as 'ARCHIVE PIECE' — the uppercase appearance is achieved via CSS text-transform. Not a bug, but worth noting for future test scripts that use case-sensitive assertions.
context_for_next_testing_agent: STAMPEDE SET Vault card mobile clipping is fully resolved at 375x800; all 8 required elements (poster, eyebrow, title, subtitle, price, archive tag, CTA) sit inside the card bbox with no overflow and no ellipsis. Gallery order on /inspiration-vault/stampede-set is exactly [worn-set, bangle-black, bangle-white-pedestal, ring-black] with correct 3rd-thumb swap and next/prev cycling. Add-to-cart works via drawer+toast (not a button-text swap) — don't assert on button label change; assert on drawer opening or on localStorage['phileon_cart']. Vault card CSS override is scoped only to .stampede-set-vault-card; no sibling regressions observed.
rca of the issue: N/A — verification-only run confirmed both fixes work end-to-end at all required viewports.
